name: Calabi-Yau Holonomy Constraint Canonical
description: Proves that CY n-fold must have holonomy_rank == n²-1 (SU(n) dimension); violations are UNSAT

cvc5.reason: cvc5 SMT solver: load_bearing proof of Calabi-Yau holonomy rank constraint

positive_test_1_cy3_rank8.interpretation: CY 3-fold with SU(3) holonomy (rank=8) is admissible

positive_test_2_cy4_rank15.interpretation: CY 4-fold with SU(4) holonomy (rank=15) is admissible

positive_test_3_cy2_rank3.interpretation: CY 2-fold (K3) with SU(2) holonomy (rank=3) is admissible

negative_test_1_cy3_rank7_invalid.interpretation: CY 3-fold with rank=7 holonomy is inadmissible (NOT a proper SU(3) holonomy)

negative_test_2_cy4_rank14_invalid.interpretation: CY 4-fold with rank=14 holonomy is inadmissible (violates SU(4) dimension)

negative_test_3_cy3_rank9_invalid.interpretation: CY 3-fold with rank=9 holonomy is inadmissible (exceeds SU(3) dimension, would be supergroup)

boundary_test_1_cy1_rank0_trivial.interpretation: CY 1-fold (complex curve) with trivial holonomy (rank=0) is admissible

boundary_test_2_cy5_rank24.interpretation: CY 5-fold with SU(5) holonomy (rank=24) is admissible
